annotation.title_en: The Mechanic and the Heart Surgeon
annotation.summary_en: An auto mechanic complains to his customer, a heart surgeon, about the unfair pay gap between their professions despite both working on 'hearts.'
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch takes place in an auto repair garage filled with wheel rims and tools. A mechanic is working on a car with the hood open, adjusting the valves for his customer. When he asks the customer about his profession, the man reveals he is a cardiovascular surgeon. Upon learning that a single heart surgery costs $3,000, the mechanic becomes indignant. He argues that life is unfair because they essentially do the same job: he works on the 'heart' of the car (the engine) all day but only receives $30, while the surgeon earns 100 times more for the same task. The surgeon listens patiently before challenging the mechanic's logic. In a witty rebuttal, the surgeon dares the mechanic to perform his repairs while the 'engine' (the heart) is still running, highlighting the life-or-death stakes of medical surgery. The sketch concludes with the mechanic facing the reality of their differing professional pressures.
catchphrases: Այ հիմա նույնն է, դե սպս սարքիր
